stories.prompt: Fix the route-permission resolver so malformed permission expressions fail closed. Empty or operator-only expressions must throw InvalidArgumentException while valid behavior remains unchanged. Do not touch the benchmark test file.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed empty or operator-only expressions throw InvalidArgumentException with message: Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.
Valid single, OR, AND, special, public, and null-permission behavior remains unchanged.
Only the frozen resolver production file and unit-test path may change.
atddConstraints: Exception assertions using PHPUnit expectException and expectExceptionMessage are authentic production-behavior assertions.
The red source must call the Platform Authz resolver directly and remain byte-preserved through green except for additive tests.

stories.prompt: Add a request-scoped run-once guard to RouteCapabilityMiddleware so the same request traversing the middleware twice evaluates the resolver and authorization exactly once. Single execution remains unchanged. Do not touch the benchmark test file.
acceptanceCriteria: The same request traversing RouteCapabilityMiddleware twice invokes RouteRequirementResolver exactly once and evaluates Gate authorization exactly once.
Only the frozen middleware production file and unit-test path may change.
atddConstraints: The nested double-traversal test must declare shouldReceive('resolve')->once(); a twice() resolver expectation contradicts the frozen product contract.
Both resolver calls and Gate evaluations are observable authorization work and must each equal one.

stories.prompt: Remove every route.permission alias from the five frozen route-registration files because the middleware is globally appended to the web group. Preserve every other route attribute and do not touch the benchmark test file.
acceptanceCriteria: All route.permission alias registrations are removed from the five frozen route files.
Other route URIs, names, handlers, groups, and middleware remain unchanged.
The frozen regression test and benchmark-focused verification pass.

stories.prompt: Fix webhook ingress retry and dedup correctness across the controller, processing job, and ingress dedup service. Unhandled controller infrastructure errors return 500. Both duplicate classifiers accept the exact SQLite provider/env_name/event_id tuple signature and retain existing cross-engine signatures while rethrowing unrelated SQLite unique violations. Do not touch the benchmark test or phpunit.sqlite.xml.
acceptanceCriteria: Unhandled Revolut webhook infrastructure errors return HTTP 500 while explicit dispatch-error handling remains unchanged.
The job and ingress service match only SQLite's provider, env_name, and event_id dedup signature; unrelated SQLite unique violations rethrow.
Existing MySQL, legacy-name, and named cross-engine duplicate signatures remain supported.
atddConstraints: Regression coverage may exercise all three allowed production files but must not require any fourth production path.
Unrelated SQLite uniqueness must be induced on event_type and must rethrow from both the service and job.
